_contract: THE OFFICIAL FORWARD BASELINE (version 2) for structural initialization: the method a new execution runs unless its own registered protocol declares a deviation. Resolved through configs/shared/baselines/selection.json by aadistill.initialization.baseline (generic) and shared.forward_baseline (this project's entry point). Every method term below is checked against the core at load: an id the core does not ship or a hash that disagrees with the shipped object is refused. AUTHORIZES NOTHING: no run, no spend, no rematerialization.

selected.decision: Maintainer decision 2026-11-03: Stage-1 search forwards use random shuffle -> sequential packing -> truncation (truncate=True) -> standard causal attention with continuous positions, for calibration (FFN, ATTENTION, WIDTH statistics and DEPTH causal KL), teacher reference, candidate forwards and state evaluation. The D1 method (operators, supervised_target_v1 positions, Top-200 + tail, scored_v1, DEPTH parent-state KL, root-teacher state evaluation, beam and Pareto ranking) is unchanged; what changes is the forward context, which is scientific identity.
selected.decision_record: logs/budget/decisions.md 2026-11-03 (sequential packing for Stage-1 forwards and Stage-3 training)

supersedes.what_stays_valid: every result, fingerprint and checkpoint produced under v1 keeps v1's identity; v1 stays loadable through selection.json :: superseded for replays

selected.is_a_selection_not_a_verdict: Version 1's statement applies unchanged: selecting the method is not a claim that D1 passed its superiority test (it returned NO-GO).

FFN.selection: activation magnitude multiplied by the down-projection column norm

DEPTH.selection: greedy forward KL of the candidate against the intact current parent

RESIDUAL_WIDTH.selection: global PCA of the residual activation second moments

method._one_implementation_per_kind: exactly one registered implementation per structural kind; operator ORDER and the calibration PROFILE per operator stay configuration-driven free variables of a search, registered by each experiment's protocol

position_policy.semantics: score the prediction positions whose targets belong to the item's `assistant` tag (for teacher-native thinking trajectories: the supervised reasoning and final-answer positions); an untemplated item with no such tag keeps every real prediction position; a present-but-empty tag fails closed. Unchanged from its historical definition.
position_policy._two_mechanisms: Target-aware selection applies to all four operators and to state evaluation (FFN, WIDTH and ATTENTION reach it through statistics_positions and the shared active-position machinery). scored_v1 is a different mechanism: pre-vocabulary ROW selection, which only paths that produce vocabulary logits have. The backbone always runs the complete causal sequence; only activation accumulation and, for KL consumers, output-head/vocabulary work at unscored positions are reduced.

distribution_support.semantics: the reference distribution's Top-200 entries plus ONE aggregate complement tail bucket, under the existing numerical-stability contract. Not renormalized truncated Top-K KL. Not D2's teacher/student union support, confidence weighting or the cancelled student-confidence objective.

kl_reference.semantics: DEPTH scores KL(P_parent || C(S)) against the INTACT CURRENT PARENT (`parent_state`, expressed by omitting the operator's kl_reference key). Global state evaluation and beam ranking compare every state with the ORIGINAL TEACHER, the lineage root. D3's original-teacher reference for DEPTH (root_reference/v1) is NOT part of this baseline.

search.matching_position_policy: the same position policy in operator selection, state evaluation and beam ranking
search.contracts: all existing scientific identity, materialization, checkpoint and evidence contracts, unchanged

forward_context.semantics: items ordered by stable id, shuffled by sha256(seed, id), packed in that order by the maintainer's reference algorithm packing_conversation(truncate=True); every placement is a prefix of its item; an item that does not fit the room left fills it with its first tokens (a fragment, scored like any placement and pooled into its item's mean) and is read again from its first token in the next sequence; each packed sequence is read with standard causal attention and position ids 0..T-1 (no block-diagonal mask, no per-item reset). Teacher reference and candidate are read in the same sequences.
forward_context.instance_values: sequence_length and shuffle_seed are each experiment's, supplied by its config (ForwardBaseline.forward_context); none is stated here

coverage.FFN, ATTENTION, RESIDUAL_WIDTH statistic: read over packed sequences; positions restricted by supervised_target_v1 per segment
coverage.DEPTH causal KL: packed path: scored_v1 rows of the packed sequences, parent sketch per packed group, per-item means over all of an item's placements
coverage.state evaluation: packed path: same suite, teacher and candidate read in the same packed sequences, sketches cached per packed segment
coverage.not implemented under a forward context: full_vocab_v1 support, the union support, scoring objectives, a declared root KL reference, attention.causal_kl_v1, CACHE_IN_MEMORY state-evaluation references

execution._meaning: micro_batch_size is PACKED SEQUENCES per forward under the forward context; calibration_batch_packing must be original_order_v1 (the packed sequences fix which items share a forward)

_execution_is_not_core: the batch size is this project's policy, carried here and in each experiment's records; src/aadistill keeps its generic defaults (prediction_rows all_v1, no forward context) so every historical identity stays byte-identical. A forward consumer takes its profile from this record, never from the core default.

reference_artifacts.label: d1_q2
reference_artifacts.role: the existing HISTORICAL reference initialization of the adopted method: D1 quality-order finalist q2, produced under the historical all_v1 execution profile. It was NOT created under scored_v1, and its digest is never the expected digest of a scored_v1 materialization. It is also NOT a product of the packed forward context: no v2 materialization shares its identities.

reconstruction.result: reproduced EXACTLY (all four identities) by the finalist-rematerialization campaign, on host drivers 580.126.09 and 595.91.07

_forward_materializations_is_empty: NO checkpoint has been materialized under this forward profile and forward context. Its semantic state ids are NOT shared with v1 (the forward context is in every calibrated operator's hashed config); a future authorized execution establishes its own identities and is recorded here only after it exists.

scored_v1_validation.result: R0 on GPU: both calibration profiles' DEPTH removal orders identical under scored_v1 and all_v1 (260 candidates each; max relative score difference 1.65e-07); state-evaluation ranked drift at most 1.28e-07. Sufficient by maintainer decision; no further validation is owed.

incumbent_distinction.forward_baseline: this record: the METHOD new executions use by default. Selecting it does not make q2 a confirmed winner over B, and historical code that asks for B to reproduce past experiments keeps asking standing_incumbent().
